## The Pitching Matchup Analysis

Yoshinobu Yamamoto versus Logan Henderson. Look at the experience differential here. Yamamoto brings elite stuff and postseason pedigree. Henderson is the less established arm in this equation. But at 50% confidence, the model is accounting for home field advantage, recent performance metrics, and bullpen depth. This is still a pick-em situation statistically.

## The Bottom Line

One game sample size from Oct 11 tells us very little. That's n=1 territory. What matters is long-term expected value. Two consecutive 50% picks in the same series? That's the model telling you these teams are evenly matched. Watch for line movement, monitor injury reports, and understand that 50% means exactly what it says: a statistical coin flip. Tomorrow we see if the Dodgers can even this series, or if Milwaukee continues to execute at home.
